spec_match.rationale: Compiles the user's pattern natively, then compiles the spec's synonym rewrite (skipping class escapes and non-Unicode patterns, and rejecting quantified assertions as the grammar does), and compares match positions.

interactive.rationale: Pattern and subject inputs (debounced), five flag checkboxes and five presets all re-run the engine.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises position marking, the verbatim compile error and the synonym comparison; all three are present.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers invalid flag combinations (u+v), non-u identity escapes, v-mode set subtraction, CR LF subjects, and rewrite gaps (reported as their own state).

references.rationale: See-also links chromestatus.com/feature/5187917373898752, the TC39 spec and explainer sections the page relies on.

conformance.rationale: Its equivalence check is the same contract as synonym-equivalence-with-modifiers.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment, so this is NOT DevTools-MCP verification), run in two modes: default and --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries. Every control was exercised at 1280x800 and at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch). Document overflow was 0px in both classes and modes, every control was at least 44px tall, and full-page screenshots were read. Default: presets with \A, \z or \Z show 'Invalid escape' and a labelled desugared-only result. Flagged: native and synonym were equivalent on every preset (for example /end\Z/u on 'the end\r\n' gives @4…7).

telemetry_health.rationale: rbb-inspector-native-equivalent and rbb-inspector-fallback-branch, fired only when the pattern really uses boundary escapes in Unicode mode.

design_system.rationale: Uses only the public/styles.css variables via the shared bb.css. Buttons set both background and color; status colours are emerald-dark/rose on stone.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, radios, checkboxes and selects with visible labels in fieldset/legend; aria-pressed on preset buttons; polite live verdicts; 3px focus outlines; tables use caption and scope inside a focusable region. The accessibility tree was not inspected with DevTools MCP, which is unavailable here.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes driven in both engine modes: 0px document overflow, 44px targets, single-column stages; wide tables scroll inside a labelled focusable region.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a Chrome 159 build where the feature is on by default or staged
openQuestions.detail: Verified only on Chrome 153 with --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries. Confirm that chrome://flags/#enable-javascript-harmony enables it once V8 marks it staged (V8 main has it in FOREACH_STAGED_FEATURE_FLAG), then update the banner when it ships by default.

openQuestions.title: Desugar rewrite vs v-mode nested classes and \q{}
openQuestions.detail: The tokenizer tracks nested [ ] only in v mode and treats every backslash pair as opaque. Fuzz it against the test262 PR 4975 cases to confirm that no class-string or \q{} edge case is mis-rewritten.

openQuestions.title: No chrome-devtools-mcp verification
openQuestions.detail: Runtime evidence comes from headless Playwright Chrome 153, not DevTools MCP; accessibility-tree inspection is still outstanding.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible text input textarea labels validation feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible <label for> on every control, hints via aria-describedby, no placeholder-only labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every input/textarea/select has a visible label; hints use aria-describedby; flags/radios are grouped in fieldset+legend.

guidanceConsulted.query: highlight text ranges custom highlight api
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use the CSS Custom Highlight API for range highlighting without DOM mutation.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: zero-width anchor positions cannot be drawn as ranges, so the inspector renders per-character spans plus ▼ markers built with textContent (no innerHTML); the textual match list is the non-visual equivalent.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region announce async result status
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live polite for standard result updates; reserve assertive for critical; debounce noisy regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Engine and result verdicts are polite live regions; typing-driven updates are debounced 120-150ms; tables are not live (the verdict summarises them).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel form without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap control rows with flex-wrap, min-width:0 on grid/flex children, intrinsic sizing.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap fieldsets; .stage children have min-width:0; long code/output uses overflow-wrap; measured 0px overflow at 360px after fixing a long unbreakable h2 on detect-and-desugar.

summary: A working anchor-position inspector. It checks the proposal's synonym claim live for any pattern, and it never presents the rewrite as native support.
